simple.meaning: נֵרְדְּ (nêrd) is a Hebrew word meaning “nard , an aromatic.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: נֵרְדְּ (H5373) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Song of Songs 1:12, with occurrences in Song of Solomon.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נֵרְדְּ (H5373) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in נֵרְדְּ (H5373) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: נֵרְדְּ (nêrd) / H5373 is traced through Song of Songs 1:12, Song of Songs 4:13, Song of Songs 4:14 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H5373. nerd נֵרְדְּ noun masculine , nard , an odorific plant from India ( via Persia) (Sanskrit naladâ ; Persian nârdîn ; Sabean, Arabic transposed according to DHM Burgen u. Schlosser 975 (SB xcvii) see also SabDenkm 82 ; Greek νάρδος [so ᵐ5 ] (through Semites) Lewy Fremdwörter 40 ; compare Löw No. 316 Lag M. ii. 25 ); — absolute ׳נ Song 4:14 ; suffix רֵיחוֺ תַן נִרְדִּי 1:12 ; plural נְרָדִים 4:13 . נֵרִיָּה see נֵר below נור
